# PVA Bazaar

PVA Bazaar is a personal website, business bridge, archive, and continuity layer.
It combines personal writings, a commerce layer, civic tools, and the HeelKawn game hub.
The site is a React + Vite SPA that uses hash routes for the live app shell.

Site URL: https://pvabazaar.org/
Sitemap: https://pvabazaar.org/sitemap.xml
Readable JSON: https://pvabazaar.org/readable-site.json
Status page: https://pvabazaar.org/status.html

Primary surfaces:
- Home: https://pvabazaar.org/
- Archive: https://pvabazaar.org/#/archive
- Marketplace: https://pvabazaar.org/#/marketplace
- Governance: https://pvabazaar.org/#/proposals
- Conference: https://pvabazaar.org/#/conference
- Forum: https://pvabazaar.org/#/forum
- HeelKawn: https://pvabazaar.org/#/heelkawn

- Career Quiz: https://pvabazaar.org/#/career-quiz

- About: https://pvabazaar.org/#/about

Notes for automated fetchers:
1. Read this file first.
2. Use readable-site.json for structured metadata.
3. Hash routes are the live SPA navigation.
4. Some operational routes require authentication.
